name: v5_condiff
_comment: IN SCOPE (same family as v4_condiff, fresh files). ConDiff (HF condiff/ConDiff, github.com/condiff-dataset/ConDiff condiff.py), 200-sample test file converted by bench/convert_v5.py condiff:<name>. Identical mapping to v4_condiff, decided in datasets_v4.md section 2.1: -div(k grad u) = f, u = 0 on the boundary, f ~ N(0,1) per cell, source = rhs, u = x (no negation), u/source re-indexed with the documented Fortran-order map, k := k_cell (derived, NOT lossless: the mean of the four corner nodes).
